units.api_call: unique message.id among assistant records (model != <synthetic>), file order
units.context_file: one *.jsonl = one agent context (main or subagent)
units.github_tool_call: Bash tool_use whose command matches gh/ghx invocation regex, or Monitor whose script does
units.linked_call: API call that Reads/cats a path that appeared in a GH command/result, or that was triggered by a task-notification of a GH background tool_use
units.episode: maximal run of GH/linked calls in one context with <= GAP_CALLS other calls between, no human turn, no compact_boundary; span = first GH call .. call after the last one
units.pr_cycle: all ci-wait/ci-status episodes on one PR number in one context

metrics.formula: count of span calls emitting >=1 GH tool_use
len(span) API calls
span_calls - linked_calls - 1
count GH tool_uses
count of gh/ghx <sub> occurrences in command texts
unique normalised signatures (tool + 2 subcommand words)
sum usage.output_tokens over span (includes thinking)
sum over GH-emitting calls of output_tokens * (GH tool input chars / all tool input chars)
sum over GH results + follow-up reads of chars/2.2 + 70
metrics.validation: R2 0.93-0.96, med abs err ~35 tok, med rel err 7-8% on >1k-char results

metrics.formula: ctx(next)-ctx(call)-output_tokens(call), only when single tool_use, next call is idx+1, <=1 record between
sum usage.cache_read_input_tokens over span
metrics.note: dominated by session context size; do not compare across arms raw

metrics.formula: span calls with ctx>5000 and cache_creation/ctx > 0.5
sum priced usage over span incl. 5m/1h cache writes and advisor iterations
sum_k [out_cost_k + input_cost_k * (ctx_k - C0 + REF_CTX)/ctx_k], C0 = ctx of first span call
sum over GH results/follow-reads of (res_tok + allocated emitting output) * min(calls until compaction/end, 50) * cache_read_price
metrics.note: depends on what happens after the episode; secondary

metrics.note: includes CI time; report, never optimise
